database.password: See ~/flow-data-simulator/config/postgres.env (FLOWSIM_READER_PASSWORD). Never copy it into specs or tickets.

watermark: row_version (bigint, strictly increasing across inserts and updates of every simulation table)

tables.name: bluebirdbev_lines
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT line_id, line_name, changeover_minutes, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_lines WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_equipment
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT equipment_id, line_id, equipment_name, equipment_class, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_equipment WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_skus
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT sku, description, cases_per_minute, reject_percent, fill_target, fill_unit, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_skus WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_shifts
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT shift_name, start_hour_utc, hours, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_shifts WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_customers
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_customers WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_employees
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT employee_id, employee_name, role, shift_name, line_id, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_employees WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_certifications
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT certification_id, employee_id, skill, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_certifications WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_parts
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT part_id, description, unit_cost, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_parts WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_failurecodes
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT failure_code, equipment_id, description, skill, priority, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_failurecodes WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_salesorders
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT sales_order, customer_id, sku, quantity_cases, created_utc, due_utc, status, completed_utc, on_time, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_salesorders WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_productionorders
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT production_order, sales_order, sku, line_id, quantity_cases, released_utc, due_utc, status, started_utc, completed_utc, good_cases, reject_cases, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_productionorders WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_productionruns
tables.description: Execution of an order on a line
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT run_id, production_order, line_id, sku, operator_id, start_utc, end_utc, good_cases, reject_cases, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_productionruns WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_downtimeevents
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT downtime_id, line_id, equipment_id, category, reason, failure_code, start_utc, detected_utc, end_utc, duration_minutes, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_downtimeevents WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_maintenancetickets
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT ticket_id, ticket_type, equipment_id, failure_code, priority, status, created_utc, downtime_id, technician_id, assigned_utc, started_utc, completed_utc, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_maintenancetickets WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_maintenanceticketstatus
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT status_id, ticket_id, status, status_utc, technician_id, note, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_maintenanceticketstatus WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_partsusage

tables.name: bluebirdbev_lots

tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT lot_id, production_order, sales_order, sku, line_id, cases, produced_utc, status, released_utc, shipped_utc, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_lots WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_qualitysamples

tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT sample_id, lot_id, line_id, sku, sampled_utc, result_utc, status, passed, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_qualitysamples WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_qualityresults

tables.name: bluebirdbev_qualityholds
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT hold_id, lot_id, sample_id, reason, created_utc, released_utc, disposition, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_qualityholds WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_inventorytransactions
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT transaction_id, lot_id, sku, transaction_type, quantity_cases, transaction_utc, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_inventorytransactions WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

tables.name: bluebirdbev_shipments
tables.incrementalQuery: SELECT shipment_id, sales_order, lot_id, carrier, quantity_cases, planned_utc, shipped_utc, status, row_version, modified_utc, is_deleted FROM bluebirdbev_shipments WHERE row_version > @watermark ORDER BY row_version LIMIT 1000

atlas.note: Starter for Atlas modeling: instances for the asset hierarchy and sensors; transactional records as query-backed properties. Not a compiled Atlas payload.

queryProperties.name: OpenMaintenanceTickets
queryProperties.query: SELECT ticket_id, ticket_type, priority, status, created_utc, technician_id FROM bluebirdbev_maintenancetickets WHERE equipment_id = [EquipmentId] AND status <> 'Complete' AND NOT is_deleted ORDER BY created_utc

queryProperties.name: MaintenanceHistory
queryProperties.query: SELECT ticket_id, failure_code, priority, created_utc, completed_utc FROM bluebirdbev_maintenancetickets WHERE equipment_id = [EquipmentId] AND NOT is_deleted ORDER BY created_utc DESC LIMIT 50

queryProperties.name: DowntimeEvents
queryProperties.query: SELECT downtime_id, category, reason, start_utc, end_utc, duration_minutes FROM bluebirdbev_downtimeevents WHERE equipment_id = [EquipmentId] AND NOT is_deleted ORDER BY start_utc DESC LIMIT 50

queryProperties.name: CurrentProductionOrder
queryProperties.query: SELECT production_order, sku, quantity_cases, started_utc, due_utc FROM bluebirdbev_productionorders WHERE line_id = [LineId] AND status = 'Running' AND NOT is_deleted

queryProperties.name: ProductionRuns
queryProperties.query: SELECT run_id, production_order, sku, operator_id, start_utc, end_utc, good_cases, reject_cases FROM bluebirdbev_productionruns WHERE line_id = [LineId] AND NOT is_deleted ORDER BY start_utc DESC LIMIT 50

queryProperties.name: AssignedTickets
queryProperties.query: SELECT ticket_id, equipment_id, status, assigned_utc FROM bluebirdbev_maintenancetickets WHERE technician_id = [PersonId] AND status <> 'Complete' AND NOT is_deleted

queryProperties.name: QualityHolds
queryProperties.query: SELECT h.hold_id, h.lot_id, h.reason, h.created_utc, h.released_utc FROM bluebirdbev_qualityholds h JOIN bluebirdbev_lots l ON l.lot_id = h.lot_id WHERE l.line_id = [LineId] AND NOT h.is_deleted ORDER BY h.created_utc DESC LIMIT 50

queryProperties.name: OpenShipments
queryProperties.query: SELECT s.shipment_id, s.sales_order, s.carrier, s.quantity_cases, s.planned_utc FROM bluebirdbev_shipments s JOIN bluebirdbev_salesorders o ON o.sales_order = s.sales_order WHERE o.sku = [ProductId] AND s.status = 'Scheduled' AND NOT s.is_deleted
